hook.name: Zhao8HookV3
hook.description: A generation-3 fee hook that charges a creator fee (up to 10%, set at deploy) plus a flat 0.2% protocol fee on every swap shape (exact-in and exact-out, buy and sell) by minting ERC-6909 claims to a fee locker vault. An optional anti-sniper premium from a creator registry is added on top, with the total capped at 50%.
